changed.detail: Explicit file/clipboard selection, dimension preflight, crop, opaque pixel masks, bounded PNG vision request, side selection and editable confirmation. Edits cancel/invalidate old recognition. No automatic window capture or image persistence.

Explicit event-driven WinMM capture up to120s or16-bit PCM WAV import, separate explicit BYOK transcription and editable confirmation. Recording remains memory-only. Speech model configurable; requires provider audio/transcriptions support.

Six original procedurally drawn cloud PNGs,30Emoji/kaomoji,20encrypted custom PNG/JPEG thumbnails, favorites, explicit clipboard image copy and PNG export. Malformed individual images remain removable without hiding the library.
100completed candidates with source/persona metadata, search, favorites, copy and polish reuse. Favorites are not silently evicted. Storage failures retain generated visible results.

Credential-free explicit DTO; PBKDF2-SHA256 with600000iterations and random salt; AES256-GCM, random nonce, authenticated version/size header, bounded reads. Password decrypt/preview then merge or reviewed replacement; preserve local API profiles. Explicit unreadable recovery keeps bad original and existing rollback.

Reads format1, writes format2 to stop old clients dropping unknown fields, and retains a separate DPAPI-encrypted .v1 rollback on the first write. Migration/failed merge/corrupt recovery regressions passed.
Manual bounded HTTPS feed, own installer URL and checksum validation, no provider credentials, no automatic download/install. Version0.3.0manifest published and HTTPS checked.

Input helpers grouped under one menu; sidebar adds history, stickers and data/update. Import failures clear old apply targets; microphone failures reset recording status; long status messages cannot consume large-text viewport.

Actual taskbar appearance, high-contrast rendering and physical interaction remain unvalidated; candidate UIElement/screen-reader integration is still missing. No unsupported immersive, secure-mode or input-mode-compartment capability registered.
Long sentences/new words/mixed languages, low memory, power/latency and extended real-app tests remain. No claim of competitor quality.

Desktop screenshot crop/redaction/vision confirmation, PCM recording/WAV transcription, PNG stickers/custom import, reply history/favorites and credential-free encrypted portable backup are now implemented. Actual microphones, real provider quality, clipboard compatibility and automatic mobile/cloud synchronization remain unvalidated or missing.
Existing iPhoneOS archive is unsigned. User has no Apple developer account; no installable IPA/TestFlight or device acceptance.
System free bytes: 365907968. Data-disk artifacts only; no other projects or databases modified.

remaining.detail: Offscreen synthetic checks cover the changed core flows and layouts. Long histories, real keyboard navigation, actual combo/model dialogs, high contrast and extended sessions still require user-machine profiling and acceptance.

Tests used synthetic WAV/PNG and localhost vision/transcription responses. No microphone opened, user chat read or paid API called. Default communication-device capture, model support, recognition accuracy and real app image pasting still need acceptance.

All screenshots/WAV/TSF text stores used for testing are synthetic; offscreen renders are not physical UI acceptance.
Local visible UI and actual application testing remain deferred by user. Preview remains unsigned.
Format2 intentionally blocks older clients from rewriting expanded data; pre-upgrade .v1 rollback files stay local and encrypted.
Backups omit provider profiles and keys; recording/images are not retained except explicitly imported custom stickers.
No mobile rebuild, backend restart, payment change or Android pointer change.
